title: Learning Flutter
practicalRequirements: Install Flutter and a supported browser or device, then run flutter doctor and flutter devices. Create a project named lesson_counter. Lesson 1 explains the setup and lesson 2 repeats the commands needed to use the supplied example.

lessons.title: Install Flutter and run a first application
Build a counter and test its buttons
Test an interface across rebuilds and restarts

seriesPrerequisites: No prior course is required; start with the setup in lesson 1 and use the linked terminal guide when needed.
nextTopics: Dart foundations, navigation, storage, accessible layouts and Framework service integration.
